reviews.title: Cheaper And Better Buy
reviews.comment: The packaging was very nice and had cable wraps for every cable. The cables have a nice braided leather feel to them kinda like the Asus power supply cables. Has been running in my pc for a week or two now and no random shutdowns or catching fire. The fan on the psu doesn’t turn off it’s always on but it’s alright cause the fan is dead silent. Switched from the Lian li sp750 which was worse quality cables and lacking 12vhpwr but 30 bucks more expensive. Received 2 damaged psus from Lian li but this one was flawless. Couldn’t recommend this unit anymore, the quality was amazing and much better value.
reviews.author: Julio C Cardona

reviews.title: A great PSU option!
reviews.comment: Fits and works perfectly in my new SFF build. I have it running an AMD 7600x and a Nvidia RTX 5070ti, and all is working perfectly. Modular cables are just the right length for small case builds and I couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Justin

reviews.title: Great PSU for the Money
reviews.comment: This PSU allowed me to connect my motherboard that required two 8pin connectors and my high power graphcis card using the 12VHPWR connector. My old PSU was a bit older and didn't have the 12VHPWR connector, so I would have needed to use 3x8pin connectors, but I still needed 2x8pin connectors for the CPU, but I only had four total 8pin connectors available. This PSU fixed the issue by including the 12VHPWR connector. The cable length on some of the cables was a little long for my case, but it was easy to bundle since the cable was so thin and individually sleeved. The Price for the power level was great. I got an 850W PSU for $110. The nearest competitor was around $170. So, this was a great value. The PSU for me has been very quiet, contrary to other user's reviews. Maybe I got lucky with my unit. Also, the black cables are pretty neutral so they should go with any build.
reviews.author: Ricky

reviews.title: Great design, Fan kind of quiet.
reviews.comment: Great PSU for the price, it is working out of the box, but the core whining quite noticeble.  I ended up return and got the 850W SFX Thermaltake Tough power.
